query:surface_highest_value.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible x-axis label as a string
query:surface_highest_value.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel box around the selected surface-cell marker

query:surface_lowest_value.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible x-axis label as a string
query:surface_lowest_value.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel box around the selected surface-cell marker

query:increase.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible series label as a string
query:increase.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "start_point" and "end_point" to [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around the answer series endpoints

query:decrease.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible series label as a string
query:decrease.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "start_point" and "end_point" to [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes around the answer series endpoints

query:panel_variation_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible panel label as a string
